item.title: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña visits SOUTHCOM
item.description: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña visited U.S. Southern Command (SOUTHCOM) March 6 and met with SOUTHCOM Commander Marine Gen. Francis L. Donovan as well as other command and Department of War leaders.

item.title: A New Era Begins: NCOLCoE Renamed United States Army Noncommissioned Officer Academy
item.description: In a significant move for the U.S. Army, the NCO Leadership Center of Excellence (NCOLCoE) at Fort Bliss, Texas, was officially renamed the United States Army Noncommissioned Officer Academy (USANCOA) on March 6, 2026. This event marks a strategic transformation to integrate the institution more fully into the Army's academic framework.

item.description: When U.S. Air Force medical teams returned to the Federation for the 2026 Lesser Antilles Medical Assistance Team (LAMAT) mission, some Airmen stepped back into familiar hospitals and partnerships they helped build during previous missions. item.description: As the Lesser Antilles Medical Assistance Team (LAMAT) 2026 mission concluded in Saint Kitts and Nevis, mental health professionals from the U.S. Air Force and local providers reflect on the partnerships built and the impact of their collaboration on mental health care across the islands. item.description: JOINT BASE SAN ANTONIO-LACKLAND, Texas – The 960th Cyberspace Wing is pioneering a new approach to complex warfare challenges through its innovative hub, Task Force-Gladiator, which has rapidly evolved from a specialized test platform into the wing's primary execution and planning arm. item.title: CW5 Danny K. Taylor retires after more than three decades of Army service
item.description: FORT LEE, Va. — Soldiers, senior leaders, family members and friends gathered to celebrate the career and legacy of Chief Warrant Officer 5 Danny K. Taylor during a retirement ceremony held at the Ordnance Training Support Facility, honoring more than 32 years of service to the U.S. Army, Mar. 3.

item.title: MSC’s Newest Ship USNS Hector A. Cafferata Jr. Christened at General Dynamics NASSCO San Diego
item.description: Expeditionary sea base USNS Hector A. Cafferata Jr. (ESB-8) the Military Sealift Command’s newest ship, was christened during a ceremony at the General Dynamics NASSCO shipyard in San Diego, Calif., today.

item.title: U.S., Saint Kitts and Nevis conclude LAMAT 2026 medical mission
item.description: U.S. Air Forces Southern and the Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis concluded the Lesser Antilles Medical Assistance Team (LAMAT) 2026 engagement during a closing ceremony in Basseterre on March 6, marking the completion of a two-week medical collaboration across St. Kitts and Nevis.

item.title: Navy Kicks Off Operation Ice Camp 2026 in the Arctic Ocean
item.description: Commander, Submarine Forces officially kicked off Operation Ice Camp (ICE CAMP) Boarfish in the Arctic Ocean on March 7, 2026, after the building of the camp and the arrival of two U.S. Navy fast attack submarines, USS Delaware (SSN 791) and USS Santa Fe (SSN 763).

item.title: USS Nimitz Conducts Milestone Departure from Naval Base Kitsap
item.description: The Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Nimitz (CVN 68) departed Naval Base Kitsap in Bremerton, Washington, for the last time in its 51-year service history, as part of a scheduled homeport shift to Naval Station Norfolk, Virginia, March 7.
